items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I had a friend of the family who was a passenger agent, American passenger agent, for the French Line

ctx.x: I must have been in high school, beginning with the first year already; it had to be that. I had a friend of the family who was a passenger agent, American passenger agent, for the French Line,
and he got us dates every summer for the kids band, going back and forth playing on the French Line, which was quite an experience.
